study_state: WSDOT final transportation report scheduled December 2026; these are reported October open-house estimates, not primary final-study tables
geography: Lower Snake River, Washington and Idaho (four federal dams)

units.transport_co2: metric tons CO2 per year (as reported)

scenarios.name: 2045 with dams
scenarios.notes: Study Scenario 3 is a 2045 reference case, not verified 2026 spending.

scenarios.name: 2045 breach without transport upgrades
scenarios.notes: $3.8–5.1B appears as transportation capital in Gazette and as road maintenance through 2045 in Barker reporting. Cost classification disputed pending original presentation/final report; excluded from apples-to-apples capital ranking.

scenarios.name: River-parallel rail and grain terminals
scenarios.notes: Barker reports 4–5.03B and ~$323M annual shipping; Gazette reports 4–5.3B and $322.9M. Preserve disagreement until verified against WSDOT primary table.

scenarios.name: Short-line rail improvements
scenarios.notes: Cost and emissions from Barker; shipping cost precision from Gazette.

scenarios.name: Class I rail capacity and terminals
scenarios.notes: Reliance on Class I freight willingness, capacity, commercial agreements is unverified.

shared_repair_in_kind.description: Repair-in-kind for bridges, rails, roads, and utilities reportedly common across breach scenarios; inclusion within reported total costs unresolved. DO NOT ADD AGAIN until cost ledger reconciled.

exclusions: tribal treaty rights and cultural resources
full dam removal and lock maintenance accounting
